headline: Las Vegas and Austin bakes have run on a frozen or missing 5-minute settlement-sensor feed since 10-03 (worker tick, not the on-demand read); Austin low missed six straight days too low; one-line trail fix so own5_last/own5_at are recorded.

findings.title: 5-minute feed frozen in LAS/AUS bakes since 10-03
findings.evidence: trail obs.own5: AUS 10-03 75.92 from 08:21-17:36 (hourly 78.08), AUS 10-04 73.4 from 07:21-19:06, LAS 10-03 75.2 07:21-15:36, LAS 10-04 absent 04:02-17:07; 8-17 changes/day before 10-02; /obs/lead now holds KLAS n=151 and /sensors reads fine; started with MADIS (70fcd747) and dark watcher (856f13ff/ff48237b); cause unverified

findings.title: AUS low: six straight misses, all too low
findings.evidence: kalshi_low_aus.json errs 09-29..10-03 -1.66/-1.54/-0.61/-3.00/-3.21, 10-04 lock 69-70 vs close 71-72 at 0.99; all non-binding, forecast 1.5-6.6F under 8 AM running min; live 16/21 vs market 21/21

findings.title: AUS high 10-03: 79-80 at 0.985 after climate report printed 78
findings.evidence: aus_high_2026-10-03.jsonl 13:56-17:31; cli 78 as of 3:18PM seen 16:46; estimate 78.08+0.83=78.91; decided_by_exact blocked by air 77.0 > 78-2

findings.title: NY high 10-04 lock missed at p=0.69 on offset estimate
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json 10-04 lock 63-64 pred 62.79 = hourly 62.06 + offset 0.72; six-hour 8-14 group 62.06; provisional actual 62, market 62- at 0.53

findings.title: LAS low 10-03 missed on the 0.47/0.51 split again
findings.evidence: kalshi_low_las.json 10-03 lock 73-74 p 0.5074 vs 71-72 0.4706, actual 71, market 0.995 on 71-72 at 8 AM; live 13/22 vs market 19/22

findings.title: Austin kernel study failed in the 10-04 refit (ruling carried)
findings.evidence: kernel.json aus_high carried 2026-10-03T13:38Z; use false so no live effect; LAS restored in kernel/dayahead

findings.title: NY noon edge court now shut on margin, not n
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json edge_gate lock n 20, ret +0.225 se 0.263; LAS n14 -0.485, AUS n17 -0.259

findings.title: Trail never recorded own5_last/own5_at
findings.evidence: 0 of 637 own5 rows on 10-03/10-04 had own5_last; trail_row reads today.own5_row which nothing wrote; kalshi_daily.py:5005 now writes it; replay aus 10-04 before None/None after 75.2/'23:45'
